envelope.description: Make capability.reuse-check use the named anchor

body.title: Make capability.reuse-check use the named anchor
body.summary: In prepareCapabilityReuseCheck (and its run path) take the candidates from the named-scope anchor when concept.resolve returns one, instead of short-circuiting on empty hits or profiling only ranked hits; handle a symbol anchor by entity id; record completeness honestly when the area is empty.
acceptanceChecks: a capability question whose wording shares no token with the named module still inspects that module
a higher-ranked child does not replace the named subject
a symbol anchor is handled by entity id

tests.name: capability-reuse-anchor.test.ts: a capability question with no lexical match still inspects the named module, a higher-ranked child does not replace the subject, a symbol anchor is handled by entity id, on both execution modes
